Echo Peak is a 5,410-foot summit in Texas.

When to Go

October through April is the comfortable window here — summer temperatures at this elevation are dangerously hot, so if you must hike in summer, start at first light and carry more water than you think you need.

Know Before You Go

Download the GPX track from this page before you go — cell coverage is unreliable in the mountains and a saved route works offline in any GPS app. Conditions change: verify current access, closures and weather with the official land manager before you go.
